transcript: Some may think this strategy is stupid, but the results say otherwise. This strategy worked every day last week. Why mess with success? Let me explain it to you. Wait 30 minutes after the New York Open, mark from the high to the low of that first 30 minute candle. This is your opening range. Drop to the 10 minute time frame. Wait for a 10 minute candle to close outside of that range. A 10 minute candle has closed outside of this range. Drop to the 2 minute time frame. Add your 20 EMA. These are your EMA settings. Wait for a 20 EMA interaction. Price has respected the 20 EMA. Enter into your long position. Stop below the pivot. Target is high of day. I take these trades live every day. If you want to learn more about my system, comment the word orb down below. I'll send you my free guide as well as a link to come join me and trade life.
